entities.summary: Skanderbeg's Resistance to the Ottomans, a transformative movement in Albania (1443–1468). Emerged from Ottoman Empire and Principality of Arbër and Feudal Lords. Catalyzed Skanderbeg raises Albanian revolt and the League of Lezhë is formed and Death of Skanderbeg; Albanian resistance continues briefly.
